alerts.title: Paradise Road Status: Open, tire chains required, gate closing at 3 p.m.
alerts.description: The road is open to Paradise. All vehicles, including 4WD and AWD, must carry tire chains and be ready to use them; today, tire chains are required to be used on all 2-wheel drive vehicles beginning 5 miles beyond Longmire and continuing up to Paradise. The gate will close to uphill travel at 3 p.m. and downhill travel at 4 p.m. to support public safety.

alerts.title: Skyline Trail in Winter: Are you prepared?
alerts.description: The popular Skyline Trail at Paradise is not a standard hike in winter from November to June. Instead of an easy-to-follow trail, Skyline becomes a snow-covered route. Conditions become dangerous, with ice and deep snow. The route is unmarked, with expert level winter navigation skills needed in places. The full Skyline Loop past Panorama Point is not recommended in the winter without expert level winter navigation and proper gear. Be prepared to ensure a safe hike or consider another trail.

alerts.title: Winter Season Closures
alerts.description: The following regular winter season road closures are in place: SR410, SR123, Westside, Paradise Valley, Ricksecker Point, Stevens Canyon, White River, & Sunrise Roads. Closed roads may be open to recreation when work is not underway on the road. Always check signs on closed road gates before proceeding.

alerts.title: WILDFIRE CLOSURES: Sunrise & northern trails.
alerts.description: Due to several active fires on the north side of the park, the following closures are in effect until further notice: Grand Park area & trails, Northern Loop Trail, Wonderland Trail from Carbon River Suspension Bridge to Frozen Lake, & associated backcountry campgrounds. White River & Sunrise Roads have closed for the winter season.

alerts.title: SR 165 Carbon River/Fairfax Bridge is closed: no access to Carbon River or Mowich Lake.
alerts.description: There is NO public access to Carbon River & Mowich Lake from SR 165. The bridge is closed to pedestrians, bicycles and vehicles and there is no alternate route.

alerts.title: All vehicles are required to carry tire chains.
alerts.description: All vehicles, including AWD & 4WD, are required to carry tire chains when traveling in the park during the winter season (November 1 - May 1). Choose the "more" link for tire chain requirement FAQs.

alerts.title: Ohanapecosh Campground area closed for construction in 2026.
alerts.description: The entire Ohanapecosh Campground area is CLOSED for the duration of the construction project, including all campsites, visitor center, restrooms, picnic area, & Ohanapecosh river access.
